```sql
WITH repeat_donors AS (
    SELECT
        "Donor",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "Receipt No") AS donation_count
    FROM donations
    GROUP BY "Donor"

),
total_donations AS (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount
    FROM donations
),
repeat_donation_value AS (
    SELECT SUM("Amount") AS repeat_amount
    FROM donations
    JOIN repeat_donors USING ("Donor")

SELECT
    (repeat_amount / NULLIF(total_amount, 0)) * 100 AS percent_of_total_from_repeat_donors,
    COUNT(DISTINCT "Donor") AS repeat_donor_count
FROM repeat_donation_value, total_donations;
```
